description: Flutter plugin for printing to Zebra label printers over Bluetooth LE, Wi-Fi (TCP 9100), and USB on iOS, Android, macOS, and Windows. Sends ZPL, reads printer status, builds labels with the included flutter_zpl_generator. Pure Dart protocols, no Zebra Link-OS SDK.
rules: Import only package:flutter_zpl_printer/flutter_zpl_printer.dart; it re-exports flutter_zpl_generator (ZplGenerator, ZplText, ZplBarcode, ...). Don't add a prefixed generator import.
Connect with `await ZebraPrinter.connect(connection)` and do not call `connection.open()` first; connect opens it.
Use TcpConnection.zpl(ip) for Wi-Fi, BleConnection(deviceId) or a DiscoveredPrinter.createConnection() for Bluetooth LE, and UsbConnection(UsbDeviceAddress.parse('usb://0A5F:PID/SERIAL')) for USB.
USB is experimental (untested on macOS and Android, failing on Windows, impossible on iOS). Prefer Bluetooth LE or Wi-Fi and never make USB the only option.
Call printer.getStatus() before printing and surface isPaperOut, isHeadOpen, isRibbonOut, isPaused to the user.
Send one command at a time per connection; overlapping requests can receive each other's replies, especially over Bluetooth.
Print images with printer.printImage(bytes, targetWidth: ...) or printer.printLabel(ZplGenerator(...)) using ZplImageDownload + ZplImageRecall.
Sgd.doCommand waits for a reply; for actions that never reply (device.reset) write '! U1 do "device.reset" ""\r\n' with connection.write instead.
Errors are ConnectionException or subclasses (ConnectionTimeoutException, ConnectionClosedException, ReconnectSuccessException, Usb*Exception). Show UsbDeviceBusyException.remediation to users.
PrinterPrintMode is the print mode reported by getStatus(); ZplPrintMode is flutter_zpl_generator's label setting.

On Android request bluetoothScan, bluetoothConnect, and location permissions before scanning; iOS and macOS need NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription, and sandboxed macOS apps need network.client, network.server, and device.bluetooth entitlements.
